archetype_1_stomp_clap_action_rock.music_bed: Stomp-Clap Action Rock Guitar Riff (boom-boom-clap + overdrive guitar slide)
archetype_1_stomp_clap_action_rock.vo_structure: 4-Beat Continuous or 1-Gap Split: Greeting (0.0..3.5s) -> [1.2s Crash Gap] -> Escalation Promise (4.8..13.5s) -> [1.2s Crash Gap] -> Launch CTA ('Let's roll!' / 'Let's jump into it!' / 'Let's go!') -> Warning Card (18.0..20.5s)
archetype_1_stomp_clap_action_rock.hook_loop_rule: Cold-Open Clip #1 (0.00s..2.00s) is replayed in full as Body Clip #1 (TLS #353 at 20.4s) or Body Clip #3-#5 (TMax #480 at 61.3s, Bzac Global #397 at 61.4s).

visual_packaging.captions: Komika Axis / Bold Italic Comic at bottom-center [0.50, 0.88], alternating Yellow / Pink / Cyan with thick black stroke
visual_packaging.pillarbox_sidebars: Static textured sidebars with repeating channel logo + top-right 'REC 🔴' indicator
visual_packaging.safety_disclaimer: *NO ONE WAS HURT* / *NO SERIOUS INJURIES* / *he is fine* at bottom-right or bottom-center

archetype_2_cctv_clause_weaving.vo_structure: 6-Clause Call-and-Response Weaving (1.1s..2.9s pure CCTV crash window between every short clause): Greeting ('Good day, folks!') -> [2.9s Crash] -> Hook ('We've got some unexpected moments caught on camera today.') -> [2.0s Crash] -> Category A ('From DIY fails...') -> [1.2s Crash] -> Category B ('...to painful mishaps.') -> [1.3s Crash] -> Retention ('Let's see who made today's list.') -> [1.1s Crash] -> Launch ('Let's go!')

visual_packaging.pillarbox_sidebars: Blue wireframe sidebars with 3D CCTV Security Camera lens (top-left) and cartoon CCTV mascot (bottom-right) + 'REC 🔴' top-right
visual_packaging.hook_loop_rule: Clip #1 at 0.00s (bridge demolition) is replayed in full at 34.0s (Body Clip #2).

channels: MEO - Incredible Moments (@MEOincrediblemoments - Moments When Things Went Wrong series)
archetype_3_hadeus_3spurt_breathing.vo_structure: Ultra-Sparse 3-Spurt Breathing: Pre-VO Cold Open (0.00..1.85s) -> Spurt 1 ('Hello everyone!', 1.85..2.90s) -> [3.4s Pure Action & Whoosh/Crash Window] -> Spurt 2 ('Are you ready to watch this video and laugh out loud?', 6.30..9.00s) -> [1.6s Action Window] -> Spurt 3 ('Let's get started right away!', 10.60..12.30s) -> [2.7s Final Crash Streak] -> Body Clip #1 at 15.02s

visual_packaging.background: 500% Scaled Gaussian Blurred Dynamic Background (no static sidebars) — identical to ITV Moments
visual_packaging.captions: Zero text clutter during teaser impacts; clean bottom-center Subscribe pill at ~34s

channels: MEO - Incredible Moments (@MEOincrediblemoments - Seconds Before Disasters series)
archetype_4_cinematic_disaster_riser.vo_structure: 2-Spurt Ultra-Suspense: Spurt 1 ('Hello everyone!' at 0.0..1.2s) -> [10.4s uninterrupted rapid-fire disaster montage (bridge collapse, warehouse shelf crash, truck explosion)] -> Spurt 2 ('This is today's wild ride around the world. Let's get started!' at 11.6..15.2s)

visual_packaging.context_captions: Journalistic bottom-left location/story captions in body clips (e.g., 'A cyclist narrowly escaped danger thanks to his quick reflexes in Paraná, Brazil on October 10 2026')

archetype_5_zero_vo_cold_open.vo_structure: Zero Voiceover. Starts at 0.00s with a high-shock or contagious-wheeze-laugh clip.
